scope: Historical recipe of deployed baseline50.9, not the new DPO trial

qwen.method: QLoRA NF4; CUDA feasibility must pass before full training
qwen.targets: all text attention/linear-attention/MLP linear modules; exclude vision/embeddings/lm_head
qwen.loss: native next-action completion tokens and EOS only; project supervised positions only
qwen.initialize_from: original pinned base; independent V2, not interrupted Kaggle optimizer/checkpoint
qwen.deployment: merged text-only full32-block GGUF Q4_K_M; no extra pruning

asr.select_checkpoint: best generated VAL WER at epoch boundaries; retain best and final adapters plus complete latest checkpoints
asr.deployment: best generated-VAL-WER adapter merged into PhoWhisper-large FP16
asr.note: Training recipe decode batch4 is not the deployed serial batch2 profile

training_input.itn: preserve original text and append deterministic number/time hints; no guessing relative dates or ambiguous values

noise.protect: negation/condition/time markers, all number words/digits and proper names; reject semantic-risk cases

heldout_note: 309 VAL has no gradient updates but has been used for selection/development, not a blind test
separate_stage: 50.5 added temporal-helper-v1 without changing Qwen weights; 50.9 swapped trained Medium for trained Large and selected serial ASR batch2 on TRAIN
not_included: No DPO/observation/other later adapters or experimental Qwen3 weights
